☛ The preposition "of" is used when selecting from specific options (e.g., "the better of the two").
☛ "Than" is used in direct comparisons (e.g., "She is taller than him").
☛ Fixed Expression: "The better of the two" is a common collocation frequently tested in exams.

☛ Apostrophe Errors: Exams often test such common mistakes. Remember: apostrophes in contractions (it’s) ≠ possessives (its).

☛ "Than" is exclusively used in comparative degree; "as...as" is mandatory for positive degree comparisons.

question: Select the sentence with the most appropriate comparative degree.

Grammar Rules:

If she had gone to the party, she could have met Amit.
options_hi: had go to the party
has gone to the party
have went to the party
No substitution required
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "No substitution required"

Explanation:
☛ Original sentence structure: "If she had gone to the party, she could have met Amit." यह एक 'third conditional' sentence है, जो past unreal situation को दर्शाता है।
☛ Underlined part "had gone to the party" grammatically सही है क्योंकि यह past perfect tense का उपयोग करता है, जो 'if-clause' में condition को दिखाता है।
☛ दिए गए options में से कोई भी इससे बेहतर नहीं है। "Had go" (grammatically incorrect), "has gone" (present perfect, जो यहाँ fit नहीं होता), और "have went" (incorrect verb form) सभी गलत हैं।
☛ Correct option sentence को grammatically accurate और naturally fluent बनाए रखता है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Third Conditional: इसका structure है - If + past perfect, would/could/might + have + past participle. यह उन situations के लिए use होता है जो past में possible थे लेकिन हुए नहीं।
☛ Past Perfect Tense: 'Had + past participle' (e.g., had gone) का use past के किसी action को दिखाने के लिए होता है जो दूसरे past action से पहले complete हो चुका हो।
☛ Common Errors: "Have went" जैसे structures avoid करें क्योंकि 'went' past simple है, जबकि past participle 'gone' होता है।

question:
Select the most appropriate form of comparative degree that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
Rohit Sharma is better than more other batsman in the world.
options: the best batsmen
better batsmen
better than most other batsmen
as good as the most other batsmen
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "better than most other batsmen"

Explanation:
☛ The original phrase "is better than more other batsman" is incorrect because "more other" is not used in comparative degree constructions.
☛ "More other" is a redundant phrase and grammatically inappropriate in this context.
☛ The correct option "better than most other batsmen" follows the proper comparative structure and maintains natural flow.
☛ "Most other" is used to compare within a group, which fits contextually here.
☛ This option is grammatically accurate and makes the sentence idiomatic.

Grammar Rules:
☛ In comparative degree, "more" is not used with "than"; instead, phrases like "most other" or "many other" are used.
☛ "Better than most other" is a fixed comparative structure showing superiority.
☛ "Other" must agree with plural nouns (batsmen), not singular (batsman).
☛ Redundancy should be avoided in idiomatic expressions – "more other" is wrong as both words convey the same sense.
question_hi:
Select the most appropriate form of comparative degree that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
Rohit Sharma is better than more other batsman in the world.
options_hi: the best batsmen
better batsmen
better than most other batsmen
as good as the most other batsmen
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "better than most other batsmen"

Explanation:
☛ Original sentence में "is better than more other batsman" गलत है क्योंकि "more other" का प्रयोग comparative degree में नहीं होता।
☛ "More other" एक redundant (अनावश्यक) phrase है जो grammatical रूप से incorrect है।
☛ Correct option "better than most other batsmen" सही comparative structure follow करता है और natural flow maintain करता है।
☛ "Most other" का प्रयोग एक group में comparison दिखाने के लिए किया जाता है, जो यहाँ contextually accurate है।
☛ यह option grammatical रूप से accurate है और sentence को idiomatic बनाता है।

Grammar Rules:
☛ Comparative degree में "than" के साथ "more" का प्रयोग नहीं होता, बल्कि "most other" या "many other" जैसे phrases का use किया जाता है।
☛ "Better than most other" एक fixed comparative structure है जो superiority दर्शाता है।
☛ "Other" का प्रयोग plural noun (batsmen) के साथ होना चाहिए, singular (batsman) के साथ नहीं।
☛ Idiomatic expressions में redundancy avoid करनी चाहिए, जैसे "more other" गलत है क्योंकि "more" और "other" दोनों same sense देते हैं।
